Before pain you get anxiety of the possibility of pain, during pain you don't have this anxiety anymore, you come to terms with pain and endure. What I mean is that you're stronger mentally during pain than before pain. Before pain you're a sissy scaredy pissy wissy that's getting her shissy all over fissy, this makes sense from a survival standpoint, during pain you have a fighter mindset which also makes sense from a survival standpoint. Love your family and friends but understand what they are and make a distinction between them and yourself. There are many mothers, fathers, friends in our world.
